- Point 3 (ModelPicker ~300 lines): 278 lines (~300). Has `fetchModels`, keyboard nav (Arrows/Home/End/Enter/Space/Escape), `loadedFor` ref + `cacheKey` probe-per-backend caching, offline UX (`llmHealth.healthy === false`), configured model marked `Current`. ✅

## Spec Compliance / Strengths / Issues / Assessment

### Spec Compliance

| # | Criterion | Status |
|---|-----------|--------|
| 1 | App.tsx wraps shell in `StudioRuntimeProvider` | ✅ (`App.tsx:73`) |
| 2 | Hero shows runtime suggestions | ✅ functionally (reads `state.thread.suggestions` via `useAuiState`, `Hero.tsx:46`); ⚠️ uses custom pills rather than the literal `ThreadPrimitive.Suggestion`/`Helper.Stop` components named in the brief |
| 3 | ModelPicker ~300 lines: fetchModels, keyboard nav, probe-per-backend caching, offline UX, configured model marked Current | ✅ (278 lines; all mechanisms present) |
| 4 | ModelPicker.test.tsx 7+ tests | ✅ (exactly 7 tests) |
| 5 | App.test.tsx renders `<App />` under `StudioRuntimeProvider` | ✅ |
| 6 | Full suite: 307 tests pass; typecheck clean; lint 0 errors | ✅ (307 passed; `tsc` exit 0; eslint 0 errors, 1 pre-existing unrelated warning) |

### Strengths
- `App.tsx` correctly nests `StudioRuntimeProvider` inside `StudioProvider`, so the runtime context is available shell-wide.
- `Hero.tsx` drives starter pills from the runtime's `thread.suggestions` (single source of truth) and keeps them in sync with what the thread knows.
- `ModelPicker.tsx` is well-engineered: probe-per-backend caching via `loadedFor`/`cacheKey` avoids redundant server hits on reopen; full keyboard navigation (Arrows/Home/End/Enter/Space/Escape); offline UX degrades gracefully; the configured model is always offered and marked `Current` even when the backend omits it.
- `ModelPicker.test.tsx` covers listing, selection, keyboard, Escape, omit-configured, unreachable-backend, and cache-once-per-backend.
- `App.test.tsx` ports a thorough mock context (18 tests) covering shell, slash commands, offline, first-run tour, and first-run setup.
- `src/test/setup.ts` provides deterministic `localStorage` and a `ResizeObserver` stub, making jsdom rendering reliable.
- All 307 tests pass; typecheck and lint are clean.

### Issues

#### Minor
- `Hero.tsx` renders suggestions as custom pills rather than via the `ThreadPrimitive.Suggestion`/`Helper.Stop` components referenced in the brief. Functionally equivalent (suggestions shown, click → `sendMessage`), but deviates from the suggested mechanism. No test covers this specific component choice.

### Assessment
**Task quality:** Approved
**Reasoning:** All functional requirements from the brief are implemented and verified: the shell is wrapped in `StudioRuntimeProvider`, Hero surfaces runtime suggestions, ModelPicker (~300 lines) implements fetchModels, keyboard nav, probe-per-backend caching, offline UX, and Current marking, ModelPicker.test.tsx has 7 tests, App.test.tsx renders under the provider, and the full suite passes (307 tests) with clean typecheck and lint. The only deviation — Hero using custom pills instead of `ThreadPrimitive.Suggestion` — is cosmetic/implementation-detail and does not affect behavior or tests.
